K33.comment: L4-33K is translated from a spliced mRNA whose intron interrupts the protein coding sequence; L4-22K is the unspliced form and shares exon 1 (PMID 25636034). Splice junctions mapped by cDNA in ovine adenovirus (PMID 7778275). Exon A lengths measured here are not multiples of 3, confirming the mid-codon intron. Called from Splice-Variants/K33.fasta, never from a profile.

VI_MAT.comment: HAdV-5 pVI residues 34-239: cut after 33 (MSGG^AF) and 239 (IVGL^GV); removes pVIn and the 11-aa protease cofactor pVIc. Cut sites are the HAdV-2/5 adenovirus protease (AVP) sites from the literature, carried to every precursor in the collection by pairwise alignment to the HAdV-5 protein; a site is accepted only where the member carries the AVP consensus (M/I/L/V)XGX^G or (M/I/L/V)XGG^X (PMID 2691633) at the aligned residue or uniquely within 2 residues. The product is installed in a module only where >=60% of its precursors carry the site. 20/20 precursors of this module cut.
